column1: 22590§probe§prəʊb§v. 探索，查究；（用探针或探测器等）探查，探测 n. 探针；探测器，探测飞船；探索，调查§The space probe sent back useful information to us.§太空探测器给我们发回了有用的信息。

22591§panic§ˈpænɪk§adj. 恐慌的 n. 恐慌，惊惶 v. （使）惊慌失措§In fact I'm starting to panic as the project deadline is in two weeks and I don't seem to be making any progress at all.§事实上，当距课题研究的最后期限只剩两个星期时我开始惊慌失措起来，因为我还是一点进展也没有。
22592§disturb§dɪˈstɜːb§v. 扰乱；弄乱，打乱；打扰，使烦恼§One of the most concerning elements of acid rain is that it disturbs the natural balance of lakes and rivers.§在酸雨带来的破坏中，最令人担心的是它破坏了河流和湖泊的自然平衡。
22593§grassy§ˈgrɑːsi§adj. 长满草的；草绿色的；似草的§To the east of us, you'll see no building at all—just trees and flowers and a huge grassy area.§在我们的东面，你根本看不到建筑物，唯有树木、花卉和大片绿地。
22594§glorious§ˈglɔːriəs§adj. 光荣的；壮丽的§Our country has a glorious past.§我们的祖国有着辉煌的历史。
22595§fertile§ˈfɜːtaɪl§adj. 肥沃的，多产的，富饶的；能繁殖的§The east of this region is flatter and more low-lying, with fertile soils.§这一地区的东部土壤肥沃，地势较为平坦，海拔也比较低。
22596§amateur§ˈæmətə(r)§n. 外行；业余爱好者 adj. 业余的§Only amateur athletes are allowed to compete in this sports games.§这次运动会只允许业余运动员参加。
22597§undisguised§ˌʌndɪsˈɡaɪzd§adj. 无伪装的；坦率的§They looked upon the creature with a loathing undisguised.§他们看那动物的眼神流露出明显的厌恶。
22598§silver§ˈsɪlvə(r)§n. 银；银器§A German alchemist tried to transmute silver into gold.§一位德国的炼金术士试图将白银炼成黄金。
22599§fulfillment§fʊlˈfɪlmənt§n. 履行；实现§The company gains its reputation from delivering fast and accurate order fulfillment services.§该公司因其快速而准确地完成订单而声名远播。
22600§aspire§əˈspaɪə(r)§v. 向往，渴望，追求；有志于，有抱负§The looks on children who aspired to go to school in some poor areas deeply moved me.§在一些贫困地区，孩子们渴望上学的眼神深深地打动了我。

22601§recession§rɪˈseʃn§n. （经济的）衰退，萧条；撤回，退回§During the economic recession, more and more countries begin to take trade protectionist measures, which is block to the global economic recovery.§经济衰退期间，越来越多的国家开始采取贸易保护措施，阻碍了全球经济的复苏。
22602§miscellaneous§ˌmɪsəˈleɪniəs§adj. 各种各样的；混杂的§A little child's pockets are likely to contain a miscellaneous collection of objects.§小孩子的口袋里往往装有各种各样的东西。
22603§utilization§ˌjuːtəlaɪˈzeɪʃn§n. 利用，使用§This research provides the scientific foundation for rational utilization of land.§这项调查为合理使用土地提供了科学依据。

22604§caustic§ˈkɔːstɪk§n. 腐蚀剂 adj. 腐蚀性的；（指评论）讽刺的，挖苦的§This paper mainly introduce the test status of filtrating equipment in medicine industry used for diaphragm caustic soda cooling process.§这篇文章主要论述了医药行业用于隔膜烧碱冷却工序的过滤装置的试验情况。

22605§detergent§dɪˈtɜːdʒənt§adj. 净化的，清洁的 n. 清洁剂§The auto beauty company often use the professional cleaning detergent foam, and then wipe the car slightly with a clean soft cloth.§汽车美容公司通常会使用专业泡沫清洁剂清洁汽车，然后用干净的软布轻轻擦拭。
22606§reclaim§rɪˈkleɪm§vt. 纠正；要求归还，收回；开垦（土地）§As he stopped the payment by installment, the finance company tried to reclaim his house.§在他停止分期付款后，该信贷公司试图收回他的房屋。
22607§deflect§dɪˈflekt§v. （使）偏斜，（使）转向§The bullet hit a wall and then deflected from its course.§子弹击中墙壁后改变了方向。

22608§trench§trentʃ§n. 沟，壕沟 v. 挖沟§The next stage of the project involves trench excavation, cable laying, construction backfilling and reinstatement, and landscaping works.§该工程的下一阶段包括坑道挖掘、电缆铺设、建筑回填和修复以及景观美化工程。
22609§holistically§həˈlɪstɪkli§adv. 整体地，全盘地§In the innovation time, the firm must design its innovation process holistically.§在这个创新的时代，企业必须全面设计自己的创新流程。
22610§urbanization§ˌɜːbənaɪˈzeɪʃn§n. 城市化，都市化§The intervention of government plays an important role in solving the problems in the process of urbanization.§政府干预对解决城市化过程中出现的问题起着重要作用。
22611§insularity§ˌɪnsjuˈlærəti§n. 岛国（状态）；与外界隔绝的生活状况；（思想、观点等的）褊狭§Japan is an insularity and such geographical feature forms its distinctive natural landscape.§日本是一个岛国，这一地理特征形成了它独特的自然景观。
22612§permeate§ˈpɜːmieɪt§v. 扩散，弥漫；渗透，渗入§As a kind of research study, this method is permeated in all the courses as well as all activities of students.§作为一种研究性学习，这种方法渗透于学生的所有课程和所有活动中。
22613§repack§riːˈpæk§vt. 重新包装；重新填塞；再装配；拆修§He had to repack his case after the customs officers opened it during the security inspection.§在海关人员打开包裹安检后，他必须重新打包他的行李。
22614§disruptive§dɪsˈrʌptɪv§adj. 制造混乱的；分裂性的；破坏性的§The school accident preliminarily resulted from some disruptive students in the crowd.§这起校园事故的初步原因是一些学生在人群中制造混乱。

22615§clinical§ˈklɪnɪkl§adj. 临床的；冷静客观的；简朴的，不装饰的§The experiment results show that the proposed evaluation method has good clinical value, which will be further accepted by more medical workers.§实验结果表明，提出的评价方法具有良好的临床价值，将进一步被更多医学工作者所接受。
22616§momentum§məˈmentəm§n. 动力，冲力，势头；动量§She worked day and night with the momentum of going abroad for further education.§出国深造是她夜以继日辛勤工作的动力。
22617§disempower§ˌdɪsɪmˈpaʊə§vt. 使失去权力或影响§You disempower yourself to do anything about it, because you always think it beyond your ability.§你总是觉得这件事超出了你的能力，所以根本没有给自己力量去做些什么。
22618§depletion§dɪˈpliːʃn§n. 削减，消耗§Many western countries have taken measures to prevent the depletion of their dollar reserves.§许多西方国家已经采取措施，防止损耗其美元储备。
22619§authenticate§ɔːˈθentɪkeɪt§vt. 鉴别，证明§There is no way to authenticate the recording at present, but the voice sounds like Lily's.§目前还没有办法鉴别这盘录音带的真伪，但是声音听起来像莉莉。
22620§anatomy§əˈnætəmi§n. 解剖（学）；解剖结构§Leon devoted his life to studying the human anatomy.§利昂毕生致力于研究人体解剖学。
22621§confidence§ˈkɒnfɪdəns§n. 信任；信心§The message is that you have little confidence.§（反馈出的）信息就是你没什么自信。
22622§commencement§kəˈmensmənt§n. 开始，开端；毕业典礼§The high school seniors engaged in high jinks after commencement.§毕业典礼后，中学毕业生狂欢了一场。
22623§chemical§ˈkemɪkl§adj. 化学的 n. 化学制品§The chemicals will contaminate water resources when drained into the river.§这些化学物质如果被排放到河里会污染水源。
22624§literal§ˈlɪtərəl§adj. 照字面的；逐字的§The literal meaning of the phrase “say what you like” is “feel free to say anything you want”.“say what you like”§这个短语的字面意思是“说你想说的，不用拘束”。
22625§comprehensive§ˌkɒmprɪˈhensɪv§adj. 全面的，广泛的；综合的；包容的§His account of the meeting was most comprehensive.§他对会议的叙述面面俱到。
22626§glue§gluː§n. 胶水 vt. 胶合，粘贴§I've prepared this so that I don't get glue everywhere.§我已经有所准备，这样就不会把胶水弄得到处都是。
22627§bureau§ˈbjʊərəʊ§n. 办公室；机构；局；处；所§§

22628§observe§əbˈzɜːv§v. 察觉；观察；遵守§She has observed that if a left-handed person is brain-damaged in the left hemisphere, the recovery of speech is quite often better than that of a right-handed person.§她观察到，如果一个左撇子的大脑左半球受损，他的语言恢复能力会比右撇子好很多。
22629§brood§bruːd§v. 沉思；孵蛋 n. （雏鸡等）一窝§In the brood chamber, the bees will stash honey to eat later.§蜜蜂在巢箱中贮藏蜂蜜，以供日后食用。
22630§interdependent§ˌɪntədɪˈpendənt§adj. 互相依赖的，互助的§The society, economy and environment are interacting and interdependent.§社会、经济和环境相互作用，彼此依赖。
22631§murder§ˈmɜːdə(r)§n./v. 谋杀，凶杀§The murder seemed planned.§这场谋杀显然是蓄意策划的。
22632§prominent§ˈprɒmɪnənt§adj. 突出的；著名的；显著的§Suzhou is one of the earlier prominent port cities.§苏州是较早的著名港口城市之一。
22633§conventional§kənˈvenʃənl§adj. 普通的，习惯的；常规的，因循守旧的，传统的§Most people prefer conventional housing now.§现在很多人偏爱传统式的住宅。
22634§productivity§ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti§n. 生产力；生产率§This process enhanced our ability to improve productivity and quality.§这一方法增强了我们提高生产力和质量的能力。
22635§viscous§ˈvɪskəs§adj. 黏滞的，黏性的§Numerous tiny worms were floating in a viscous liquid.§黏稠的液体里飘浮着无数的小蠕虫。
22636§transform§trænsˈfɔːm§v. 使改观，改革，改善；变换，把…转换成§The new genetical anatomy will transform medicine and reduce human suffering in the twenty-first century.§在21世纪，新的基因解剖学将彻底改变药品形式并减轻人类的痛苦。
22637§strategist§ˈstrætədʒɪst§n. 战略家§The Japanese strategist talked about the impact of globalization on nations.§那位日本战略家谈到了全球化给各国带来的影响。
22638§indulge§ɪnˈdʌldʒ§v. 沉溺于，纵情于；满足（欲望、兴趣等）；放纵，听任§Overseas visitors like to come here to indulge in one of Astoria's more famous agricultural products—wine.§外国游客喜欢到这里尽情品尝美酒，这是阿斯托里亚较出名的农产品之一。
22639§personality§ˌpɜːsəˈnæləti§n. 人格；个性，性格；名人，人物§If you are in a role for long, it eventually becomes part of you, part of your personality.§如果你长久地处于一个角色中，最终它将成为你的一部分，成为你个性的一部分。
22640§definition§ˌdefɪˈnɪʃn§n. 定义，释义；清晰（度）§The definition of any individual's role in any situation will be a combination of the role expectations.§任何情况下对任何个人角色的定义都会是对角色期待的综合。
22641§host§həʊst§n. 主人；东道主，主办方；大量，许多 v. 主办；招待§We will be hosting more than 250 participants for the lectures and workshops.§我们将接待250多位参加讲座和讨论会的人员。
22642§feminism§ˈfemənɪzəm§n. 男女平等主义；女权主义；女权运动§We discuss everything from personal experience to future society and feminism.§我们从个人阅历、未来社会或男女平等主义的角度来讨论每件事。
22643§abate§əˈbeɪt§v. 减轻；降价§After the closedown of the airport, noise pollution abated.§机场关闭后，噪音污染减轻了。
22644§expectation§ˌekspekˈteɪʃn§n. 期待，预期，期望；[pl.] 前程，成功的前景§The company failed to meet shareholders' expectations.§公司没有满足股东的期望。
22645§excessive§ɪkˈsesɪv§adj. 过多的，极度的，过分的§Each month, managers would analyse the pattern of absence of staff with excessive sick leave.§每个月，经理们都会分析请过多病假的员工的缺勤模式。
22646§brilliant§ˈbrɪliənt§adj. 光辉灿烂的；卓越的，有才华的§That's a brilliant solution to the problem.§那可真是一个解决问题的好办法。
22647§seminar§ˈsemɪnɑː(r)§n. （大学的）研究班；研讨会§You should prepare before you attend this seminar.§参加这次研讨会之前你应该准备一下。
22648§navigable§ˈnævɪgəbl§adj. 可通航的；适于航行的§The depth of the navigable channel of this river is 40 feet.§这条河可航行河段的水深为40英尺。
22649§foul§faʊl§adj. 发臭的；肮脏的；邪恶的 n. 犯规§The football player was penalized for his foul.§那名足球运动员因为犯规而被判罚。
22650§contemplate§ˈkɒntəmpleɪt§v. 思量，沉思；注视，凝视；打算，预期§In order to compete in the world market, we contemplate improving our present product.§为了参与国际市场的竞争，我们打算改进现有产品。
22651§budget§ˈbʌdʒɪt§n. 预算，预算经费 v. 做预算§I'm going to talk about ways of making sure that you eat well while at the same time staying within your budget.§我将会谈到一些方法，让你在不超过预算的前提下吃好。
22652§flee§fliː§v. 逃走；逃避§Citizens were forced to flee the besieged city.§居民们被迫逃离这座被围困的城市。
22653§worthwhile§ˌwɜːθˈwaɪl§adj. 值得花费时间（或金钱）的，值得做的§I'm sure you've done many worthwhile things in the last ten years.§我确信在过去的十年里，你做了很多有意义的事。
22654§clamp§klæmp§v. （用夹具等）夹紧，夹住 n. 夹具，夹钳§If you do not have a parking sticker, the workers will clamp your car wheel and give you a fine.§如果你没有停车许可证，工作人员会夹住你的车轮并对你进行罚款。
22655§convenience§kənˈviːniəns§n. 方便，便利；便利设施§The newly-built apartment building provides gas, electricity and other modern conveniences.§这幢新盖的公寓大楼提供煤气、电以及其他一些现代化便利设施。
22656§migrant§ˈmaɪgrənt§n. 移居者，移民；迁移动物，候鸟§The migrants fly to the south before winter.§候鸟在冬天来临之前飞往南方。
22657§specify§ˈspesɪfaɪ§v. 明确指出，详细说明明§It is not necessary to specify quantity when ordering beer.§预定啤酒时无需指定数量。
22658§deviance§ˈdiːviəns§n. 异常；偏常行为§The investigation of deviance can reveal interesting and significant aspects of “normal” societies.§对偏常行为的研究会揭露出“正常”社会中一些有趣且重要的情况。
